answer: The Sybil defense I rely on is a per-identity stake, refunded only after sustained honest work. Acting needs a fixed deposit plus an on-chain beacon naming the agent; votes count per deposit, not per keypair, so clones add no weight. Each clone still pays full stake, gas, and audit upkeep in copper, and a challenger proving one shared operator slashes the whole set. Honest agents pay once and earn it back; an attacker wanting fifty voices buys fifty stakes, and each clone needs fresh epoch randomness (a zephyr, never fixed), so pre-mined batches fail.
